verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a JumpCloud integration doc page (title only), which suggests an MDM/directory integration exists, alongside generic continuous-monitoring claims. Nothing shows per-employee workstation checks or what device posture is actually evaluated. Missing for 10: documented Sprinto endpoint agent, per-employee device compliance tracking, disk encryption checks, screen lock checks, password manager checks, details of what the MDM integration collects, independent or hands-on corroboration.
